fields.name: Navadvīpacandra dāsa (disciple of Rādhāramaṇa-caraṇa dāsa)
fields.place: Born in East Bengal; Navadvīpa; Vṛndāvana
fields.notes: Born in East Bengal; met Rādhāramaṇa-caraṇa dāsa Bābājī near Nṛsiṁha-deva's hermitage at Navadvīpa and became his inseparable disciple, able to read his guru's thoughts; a humble preacher. Sent by his guru to Vṛndāvana, he died there in 1902. (The padakartā of Padakalpataru 2961 and Navadvīpacandra Gosvāmī Vidyāratna have their own records since 11-11-2026.)

fields.name: Kṛṣṇadāsa Bābājī (Navadvīpa)
fields.aka: Śrīla Kṛṣṇadāsa Bābājī (of Navadvīpa), Keśava, Kiśora (birth names)
fields.disappearance: Māgha 1326 BS (1919), at Navadvīpa, before the samādhi of Siddha Caitanya dāsa Bābājī (the record's text)
fields.place: Born at Śrīhaṭṭa; Navadvīpa; Purī (14 years); Vṛndāvana (24 years); Śrīkhaṇḍa (7 years)
fields.guru: Siddha Caitanya dāsa Bābājī of Navadvīpa (dīkṣā); Dīnahīna dāsa Bābājī of Śrīhaṭṭa (veśa)
fields.notes: Born Keśava (Kiśora) of the Navaśākha clan at Śrīhaṭṭa, 1818; dīkṣā at thirty from Siddha Caitanya dāsa Bābājī, who kept him a householder ten more years; after his wife's death (1858) took veśa from Dīnahīna dāsa Bābājī and the name Kṛṣṇadāsa. Bhajana at Purī, Vṛndāvana, Śrīkhaṇḍa and Navadvīpa by his guru's orders; died 1919 before his guru's samādhi.

fields.name: Jagacchandra Ghoṣ (Jayakṛṣṇa dāsa)
fields.aka: Jagachandra Ghosh, Jayakṛṣṇa dāsa (veśa name), Buḍā Bābā
fields.guru: Kṛṣṇadāsa Bābājī of Vṛndāvana (veśa, 1853; which Kṛṣṇadāsa is not said)
fields.notes: Born 1775 at Pāñcthupi; knew Bengali and Persian; a householder of strict devotion (faith in prasāda, Harināma, the Harivāsara vow). In 1853 took veśa in Vṛndāvana from a Kṛṣṇadāsa Bābājī as Jayakṛṣṇa dāsa; lived twenty years on mādhukarī, «Buḍā Bābā» at Madhumaṅgala-kuñja; died 1871.
